subtitle: As we learn together, our little home grows.

growth.progressLabel: Experience toward the next companion level
growth.meaning: Your level records learning and adventure, not ontology accuracy or completed review.
growth.startTitle: Begin an adventure in your project
growth.startBody: Open an ontology folder with a project. Explore concepts to earn experience, then keep discoveries to grow your companion’s home. Samples do not earn experience.
growth.exploreHint: A first look earns {xp} XP. Reopening the same concept does not earn more.
growth.allExplored: You have visited every concept in this project. Keep a discovery or return to an open question.
growth.reflectionHint: Once per concept, keep a discovery for {xp} XP. Finding an unanswered question earns the same experience.
growth.notePlaceholder: Keep a responsibility you learned, a reason for a correction, or a question to explore.
growth.saved: Discovery kept. Editing does not earn duplicate experience.
growth.empty: Your first footstep is waiting. Explore a concept to leave it here.
growth.missing: This concept is no longer in the current folder. Your past experience remains.
growth.rules: Preview a concept here for {explore} XP, then keep a discovery about it for {reflect} XP. Each activity counts once per concept. Generated node counts and approvals do not earn XP. Personal memories are not converted into experience.Adventure rewards accumulate separately. Away progress is capped at four hours.
growth.storage: Growth and discoveries stay on this device. They are separated by project UID; copies of the same project share progress. Clearing app data removes them.
growth.unreadable: Growth records could not be read. Existing data is preserved and no new experience is being saved.
growth.failed: Growth could not be saved. Your discovery draft is still here.
growth.resetPrompt: Clear this folder’s reading XP and discoveries on this device? Construction XP, personal memories and ontology files remain.
growth.full: You have 2,000 growth records. Existing records have not been overwritten.
growth.noDescription: This concept has no description yet. Open the map to inspect its connections and source.
growth.gameUnavailable: Adventure records could not be read or saved. Existing data was not overwritten.
growth.offline: While away: {wins} victories, +{xp} XP and +{gold} G.
growth.resetGamePrompt: Clear adventure XP, gold, equipment and the bestiary? Learning records, personal memories and ontology files stay as they are.
growth.xpBreakdown: Project and reading {knowledge} XP · Adventure {adventure} XP

life.title: A little day together
life.hint: Tap your companion or the furniture.
life.playful: Life in this room is play, separate from your coding agent’s actual work.
life.reduced: Reduced motion is on. Use the buttons to choose your companion’s activity.

activity.walk: A little stroll around the room

game.autoBattle: Auto battle · the adventure continues while you are away
game.fiction: Monsters and battles belong to the game. They do not represent code defects or ontology quality.
game.noAreas: Your ontology domains become regions. Open a folder containing domains to explore.
game.regionGoal: Explore concepts to unlock regions, defeat monsters, and grow your equipment.

world.hint: WASD move · E interact · I bag · K skills
world.controls: WASD / arrows to move · Click the ground to walk · Click a creature for a ready knowledge wave · E interact · I inventory · K skills · M map · J journal · Q knowledge wave · 1 potion · R rest · Esc close panel · B blessings · Space dodge · N Creature field guide · L Quests · T learning expedition
world.projectReward: Your project records became strength · +{xp} XP

description.sword: Each upgrade adds 2 attack. Spend gold earned from monsters.
description.armor: Each upgrade adds 8 maximum HP, helping you explore longer.
description.library: Each upgrade adds 1 XP per defeated monster.
description.potion: Restores 20 HP. The recovery skill increases its effect.
description.cards: Real concepts in this folder. Read them together and keep discoveries at the desk.
description.relic: Relics earned from guardians and quests. Used to enhance personal equipment beyond +5.
description.bestiary: Discover 108 creatures, their behavior, and your defeats. Prepare for the next journey.
description.quests: Claim guardian relics from recorded construction, reading, and companion work to grow your equipment.

skills.earn: Earn one point per level, up to 30 points across six skills.

effect.wave: Adds 0.25 to the damage multiplier of your Q knowledge wave per rank.
effect.fortune: Adds 1 gold per defeated monster per rank.
effect.insight: Adds 1 XP per defeated monster per rank.

project.how: Concepts 24 · relations 8 · implementation links 16 · wiki pages 40 XP. Every 40 words adds 4 XP, up to 10 units per document. Folder refreshes record category high-water marks; cleanup never removes progress. Code work counts when reflected in these records. This is not a correctness score.
project.sigil: An archive constellation grown from concepts, relations and wiki pages
project.sampleEmpty: Open your folder and this record starts to grow. The sample is not counted.

run.title: Expedition blessings
run.chooseHint: {count} picks available. Choose one of three. Battle resumes when you close this panel.
run.nextHint: Reach the next floor to choose another blessing.
run.campHint: Depart to choose your first blessing.
run.temporary: Blessings last for this expedition. Equipment, skills and construction growth carry into the next run.
run.available: B · A new blessing is available
run.record: Best floor {best} · {clears} clears. Menus pause battle; time away still advances it.

effect.ember: Adds 3 attack. Stack it for stronger strikes.
effect.ward: Adds 12 maximum HP and immediately heals 12.
effect.leech: Heals 3 additional HP after each victory.
effect.haste: Shortens the wave cooldown by one turn.
effect.thorns: Reflects 3 damage when a monster hits you.

run.dodgeHint: Avoid the next attack. Recharges in four turns.
run.cooldownTurns: Ready in {count, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}
run.cleared: Last expedition: guardian cleared! Rewards kept. M plans your next run.
run.defeated: Last expedition: defeated, rewards kept. M prepares another run.

adventure.fiction: Original game creatures; never ontology evidence.

effect.calm: Quiet trail · Standard encounters and rewards.
effect.vital: Restorative ground · +3 HP after each victory.
effect.fortified: Ancient walls · Enemies have 25% more health.
effect.insight: Archive fragments · +4 adventure XP per victory.
effect.elite: Guardian approach · Enemies deal 20% more damage.

trait.armored: Armor: takes 20% less damage. Strengthen your blade.
trait.fierce: Fierce: attacks deal 30% more damage. Time a dodge.
trait.mender: Regeneration: heals before each regular strike. Burst with Q.
trait.siphon: Siphon: restores half the damage it deals. Dodge to deny healing.
trait.swarm: Swarm: attacks twice for reduced damage; armor blocks each hit.
trait.arcane: Arcane shell: takes 30% less wave damage. Regular attacks remain effective.

journey.title: Expedition plan
journey.persists: Changes apply at floor entry, never immediately. Your preference carries into automatic retries.

effect.camp: Recover up to {hp}% HP on entry; −{gold} G per victory.
effect.elite: Enemy HP +{health}%, damage +{damage}%; +{gold} G / +{xp} XP per victory.

quests.title: Traveler’s quests

requirement.concepts: Record {goal} ontology concepts in the current folder
requirement.relations: Record {goal} resolved connections in the current map
requirement.reflected: Record discoveries, corrections, or uncertainty on {goal} distinct concepts
requirement.acp: Inspect {goal} concepts with confirmed body saves through Agent Client Protocol (ACP)

quests.unavailable: No current source is available. Earned rewards remain.

acp.verified: Completed writes and their current concepts are available in this folder.
acp.unavailable: No verifiable completion record is available for this folder. Older history may no longer be retained.
acp.failed: The last work did not complete. No reward was added.
acp.rejected: The request was declined and did not run. Ordinary quests remain available.

quests.boundary: Game rewards record activity, not correctness or meaning acceptance.
quests.alternative: Six ordinary quests unlock every forge tier without ACP.
quests.sendTitle: Send this request to the agent
quests.request: Read the existing ontology and evidence in the current Atlas folder, then propose genuinely needed body improvements. If evidence is insufficient, preserve uncertainty and do not write. Do not create arbitrary documents or approvals for quest rewards. Any actual write must follow the existing approval process.
quests.helpUnavailable: No available ACP agent accepted the request. Nothing was sent.

milestone.armor: Every +5: +5 max HP · current equipment bonus +{bonus}
milestone.library: Every +5: +0.25 wave multiplier · current equipment bonus +{bonus}

forge.gate: Claim {count}/{needed} quests for the next enhancement. Previously earned equipment remains.
forge.cost: Enhance · {gold} G + {relics, plural, one {# relic} other {# relics}}
forge.materials: Relics {count}/{needed} · Earned from quests and guardians

source.title: Current saved document
source.unavailable: This source is unavailable. No older text is substituted.
source.changed: This document changed. Read it after the folder refreshes, or open it in the project.
source.large: Open this long document in the project.
source.empty: This document has no body yet. Its business responsibility still needs evidence.
source.boundary: These are the saved words, not a correctness or understanding assessment.
source.draftPending: Save or clear your new note before leaving the game. You can return to the expedition with the draft intact.

learning.campBody: Finish the current combat expedition and return to camp to begin a learning expedition. Earned rewards remain.
learning.returnCamp: End combat and return to camp
learning.intro: Read its responsibility and boundary, trace a recorded dependency, then explain what you can and cannot conclude.
learning.rewardRule: Reading 5 XP and reflection 15 XP, once per concept. Uncertainty and corrections count equally.
learning.empty: Record a concept with a responsibility to begin. The game does not invent business meaning.
learning.retainedDraft: Retained unsaved note. Clear it to choose another topic.
learning.recordBoundary: A recorded link is evidence to inspect, not proof of semantic truth or code impact.
learning.changed: The topic or its evidence changed. Read it again before continuing; your note is retained.
learning.unavailable: The current saved evidence could not be verified. Refresh the folder before continuing.
learning.missingPurpose: No separate purpose paragraph was found. Keep that gap visible in your explanation.
learning.missingBoundary: No separate exclusion section was found. Open the full source before inferring its boundary.
learning.relationQuestion: What directly depends on {title}, according to the record?
learning.missingLink: No resolved direct dependency on {title} is recorded here. That does not establish that nothing depends on it.
learning.matchesRecord: This matches the recorded direct relation.
learning.tryEvidence: That choice does not match this declaration. Inspect the original direction.
learning.checkWitness: Compare the original declaration, not the names alone.
learning.keepUnknown: Keep the evidence gap and continue
learning.candidate: If this topic changes, {title} is a recorded candidate to review.
learning.reasonUnknown: Inspect the declaring document for the reason and its limits. A reason is not inferred from the link.
learning.missingImpact: No direct review candidate is established by these records. Preserve the unknown; do not conclude “no impact.”
learning.impactBoundary: Only this direct declaration is shown. Runtime impact and transitive effects need further evidence.
learning.reflectionPrompt: Describe the responsibility, the relation, and what remains uncertain.
learning.noteLimit: {count} of 240 characters. Keep one concise explanation or question.
learning.completedBoundary: This records your activity and explanation; it does not certify understanding or approve meaning.
learning.saveFailed: The note was not saved. Your draft remains; retry after storage is available.
learning.verifyFailed: Not saved: evidence changed or unreadable. Your draft remains.
learning.refreshEvidence: Refresh and read the evidence again
learning.noteHint: Opens the field note you already saved.
learning.recallBoundary: A personal note from an earlier exploration. Read current evidence before treating it as a current conclusion.
learning.reexploreHint: Read the current saved sources before revising this note.
learning.currentUnavailable: Current source unavailable. Your note is kept.
learning.noteUnavailable: This saved note is unavailable in the journal.
